resources.string: This phone is now linked. Your calls will appear in Yaad a few minutes after they end.
No connection to Yaad. It will try again.
This phone was unlinked from Yaad. Open Yaad and sign in again.
Yaad is busy (error %1$d). It will try again.
Not linked yet. Open Yaad and sign in.
Yaad reads your call log to keep a summary of each call: what was said, what was decided, and what to do next.
If Android says this setting is restricted: open App info for Yaad, tap the ⋮ menu, choose "Allow restricted settings", then try again.
Pick the folder where your phone saves call recordings. Yaad reads only that folder.
Set battery use for Yaad to "Unrestricted" so calls keep syncing in the background.
Calls with these numbers are never sent to Yaad. The list stays on this phone.
Unlinked. Sign in again in Yaad to link this phone.
